title: Code and protocol for: An organ-system-constrained model for interpretable early warning after acute myocardial infarction
description: Analysis code, analysis protocol with all amendments, correction note and freeze note. No patient data are included; MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-IV-ECG and eICU-CRD are available to credentialed users through PhysioNet.
